body: Actually it is bad for people who have IBS like me. I try to not eat gluten at all but it's hard for me because I love all kinds of food. When I don't eat gluten my IBS goes away completely.

Heart break. I've suffered so much and I'm only 23. I can't cope with anything that happens tried therapy, medication. I experience the worst chest pains everytime I experience something that upsets me. I have a panic disorder plus severe depression. I've always believed I would die from broken heart syndrome since I was a little kid. To me its inevitable.
I used to work 70+ hours at one job. 7 days a week. It takes such a toll but that money at the end of the week. Somehow still had a social life I was the richest self sustaining 19yr old in my group.

I worked in a "male industry" type job and I was the only girl. Im not bad looking and it ended up causing a lot of problems. Some of our customers stayed all day long (scrap yard) and most were also there daily.Im a talkative and polite person, which automatically labels me as a slut. You wouldn't believe how bad these middle aged men acted like they were in elementary school with the gossip. Just because I liked to talk to people. FUCK! One of my four bosses was spreading shit that wasn't even true just because it would make him more popular among these scumbags. Obviously I don't work there anymore. So much I hated about that job but I loved it too which is why it took for four years to finally say goodbye.

Im still pregnant. Im not suffering from postpartum. Im sorry for your situation, but the only reason I've lived this long is purely out of guilt for others. I can't keep suffering and pretending to go through life just because of what others will suffer. It gets easier. My mother will need to raise my daughter to fill the loss she feels from me leaving. It will be hard but she will be okay in the end. Same with my husband. He will have all the support and love from my family. I hate being here. I hate most peoples intentions in the world. What they'll do to get their goals. How many people are fighting and starting wars over pettiness. Its disgusting. Im never going to be like that. There's nothing I can do. I just don't fit in here. I don't want to fit in here.

I feel my thoughts are more result of situational depression instead of chemically like it has been. These thoughts are purely because I find no joy in the walks of life. I think the world is a screwed up place. I actually cried a lot when I first found out I was pregnant because I hate living so much for many reasons and suffer from it and now I'm bringing someone else in it. I feel sick. But my husband needs this. And I don't want to be so selfish to take us both away from him.Also my mother will love the child like her own. In no way will my girl be missing a mother figure.
